senses.gloss:
r. 1st cl. (कशति-ते)
To kill, to hurt.

f. (-शा)
1 A whip.
2 Whipping, flogging.
E.
कश to hurt, अच् and टाप् affixes; also कष.

r. 1st cl. (कषति) 10th cl. (कषयुति)
1 To injure, to hurt, to destroy, to kill.
2 To try, to test: with नि, to try metals.

m. (-षः)
The touchstone.
f. (-षा)
A whip; also कशा.
E.
कष to hurt, to test or try, अच् and टाप् affs.

r. 1st cl. (कसति)
To move, to go or approach:
with वि prefixed,
to open or expand as a flower, to blow.
(इ) कसि r. 2nd cl. (कंस्ते)
1 To go.
2 To command.
3 To destroy: this root is also read by some authorities, कस (कस्ते) or कशि (कंष्टे.)

m. (-सः)
A touchstone: see कष.
f. (-सा)
A whip: see कशा and कषा.

(ऋ) काशृ r. 1st cl. (काशते) also (उ, ऋ) (उकाशृ) r. 4th cl. (काश्यते)
1 To shine.
With निर् prefixed,
To expel.
2 To hide or obscure;
with प्र,
To make or become manifest.

m. (-शः)
1 Cough, catarrh: see कास.
2 Sneezing.
n. (-शं)
1 A species of grass, (Saccharum spontaneum.)
2 Irritation in the throat.
f. (-शी)
Kāśi or Benares, the holy city so called.
(-शी or -शा)
Saccharum spontaneum, as above.
E.
कश to sound, in the causal form, अच् affix; or काश to shine, अच्, and ङीष् fem. aff.

r. 1st cl. (ऋ) कासृ (कासते)
1 To make a bad sound, or one indicating disease; to cough.
2 To shine: see काश.

m. (-सः)
1 Cough, catarrh.
2 A species of reed or long grass, (Saccharum spontaneum.)
3 Morunga, (Hyperanthera, &c.) see शोभाञ्जन.
E.
कास to cough, to make an unpleasant sound, अच् affix; also काश to shine, &c. see काश.

n. (-यं)
Three modes of whipping (a horse), good, bad, and middling.
E.
कषा, and त्रयम् three-fold.

mfn. (-र्हः-र्हा-र्हं)
Deserving a whipping.
E.
कशा a whip, and अर्ह to be fit or proper.

m. (-पुः)
1 Food.
2 Clothing. du.
m. (-पूः)
Food and clothing.
E.
कश to injure, to remove, (pain, hunger, &c.) पु affix, the form is irr.

m. (-पुः)
Food, boiled rice: see कशिपु.

mn. (-रुः-रु)
The back bone.
f. (-रूः)
A kind of grass, (Scirpus kysoor.)
m. (-रुः)
One of the nine divisions of Jambu Dvīpa.
E.
क sound, शृ to harm, ऊ or उ Uṇādi affix, and एरङ् substituted for the radical vowel.

m. (-रुः)
A sort of grass: see कशेरु, &c.

f. (-का)
The back bone.
n. (-कं)
A sort of grass, (Scirpus kysoor.)
E.
कन् added to the preceding.

f. (-का)
The back bone, the spine: see कशेरुका.

f. (-का)
1 A sort of grass.
2 The back bone: see कशेरुका.

n. (-रुः)
A grass, (Scirpus kysoor): see कशेरु.

ind.
Some body, a certain person; the first member of the compound is declinable, as कश्चन, कस्यचन, &c.

ind.
Some body, some one, a certain one: the first member of the compound is declinable, as कश्चित्, कस्मैचित् &c.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Foul, dirty.
m. (-लः)
1 Fainting, syncope.
2 Sin.
E.
कश to go, क्मलच् aff.

n. (-लं)
1 Fainting, syncope.
2 Sin: see कश्मल.

m. (-रः)
The name of a country, Kāṣmir.
E.
कश to go, ईरन् Uṇādi affix, and मुद inserted: see काश्मीर.

n. (-रं)
1 A plant with a tuberous root, a sort of costus, (Costus speciosus.)
2 A country, Kashmir, or in the plu. (-राः) its inhabitants.
f. (-री)
A tree, (Ficus elastica.)
E.
कश्मीर Kashmir, and अण् affix; produced in that place.

m. (-न्मा)
Saffron: see काश्मीरजन्मन्.

n. (-न्म)
Saffron.
E.
काश्मीर, and जन्मन् birth; produced in Kashmir.

mfn. (-श्यः-श्या-श्यं)
Deserving a whipping.
n. (-श्यं)
1 Spirituous liquor.
2 A horse's flank.
E.
कश to beat, यत् aff.

n. (-श्यं)
Spirituous liquor.

m. (-पः)
1 The name of a Muni or deified sage, the son of MARĪCI, and father of the gods, demons, animals, fishes, reptiles, &c. by the seventeen daughters of DAKṢA.
2 A kind of deer.
3 A sort of fish.

m. (-पः)
1 The name of a saint; also called KAṆĀDA, the son of KAŚYAPA.
2 A name of ARUṆA: see the next.
3 A sort of deer.
4 A tribe of Brahmans pretending to descend from KAŚYAPA.
E.
कश्यप a saint, and अण् affix of descent.
n. (-पं)
Flesh.
E.
काश्य spirituous liquor, and प from पा to drink or cherish.

m. (-नः)
A name of GARUḌA The bird of VIṢṆU.
E.
कश्यप, and नन्दन a son, the son of KAŚYAPA.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Unripe, immature.
n. (-णं)
1 Touch or test of gold by the touchstone.
2 Rubbing, marking.
E.
कष to hurt, affix युच्.

m. (-णः)
A touchstone.
E.
कष and पाषाण a stone.

m. (-कुः)
1 The sun.
2 Fire.
E.
कष to injure, आकु Uṇādi aff.

m. (-तः)
A cut, a stroke with a whip.
E.
कषा and आघात a blow.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
1 Astringent.
2 Fragrant.
3 Red, dull red.
4 Brown, of a colour composed of red and yellow.
mn. (-यः-यं)
1 An astringent flavour or taste.
2 A decoction or infusion.
3 Gum, resin, extract, exudation from a tree, &c.
4 Plastering, anointing.
5 Colouring or perfuming the person.
6 Attachment to worldly objects.
m. (-यः)
1 A plant, (Bignonia Indica.)
2 Passion, emotion.
f. (-या)
A plant, a small sort of Hedysarum.
E.
कष to injure, आय aff.

mfn. (-यः-यी-यं)
Red, dyed of a reddish colour.
E.
कषाय, and अण् aff.

m. (-कृत्)
Red. Lodh, a tree the bark of which is used in dyeing.
E.
कषाय red, कृत् what makes.

mfn. (-त्रः-त्रा-त्रं)
Dyed or stained of a dull red colour.
E.
कषाय, and चित्र painted.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Astringent, harsh.
E.
कषाय, and अन्वित having.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Prepared for dyeing or colouring.
E.
कषाय nominal verb, to astringe, and क्त aff.

mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि)
1 Yielding a resinous exudation.
2 Astringent.
3 Dyed of a red colour.
4 Worldly minded.
m. (-यी)
The Śāl tree.
E.
कषाय and इनि aff.

mfn. (-षिः-षिः-षि)
Injurious, mischievous.
E.
कष to hurt, and इन् aff.

f. (-शिः)
Kāśi, a celebrated city and place of pilgrimage, the modern Benares.
E.
काश to shine, to be beautiful or renowned, and इन् Uṇādi affix; also काशीः see काश and काशिका, काशिकी.

f. (-का)
A bird in general.
E.
कष to hurt, and इकन् Uṇādi aff.

f. (-का)
Kāśi or Benares: see the preceding.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Hurt, injured.
E.
कष to hurt, क्त aff.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
1 Pained, suffering pain.
2 Impervious, impenetrable.
n. (-ष्टं)
Bodily pain or uneasiness.
ind. (-ष्टं)
An exclamation of regret or sorrow, ah, alas!
E.
कष to hurt, participial affix क्त.

mfn. (-रः-री-रं)
Giving pain or trouble.
E.
कष्ट, and कर what makes.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Causing trouble or annoyance.
m. (-कः)
The world.
E.
कष्ट pain, and कारक the maker, the cause.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Suffering pain or misfortune, undergoing hardships, performing penance.
E.
कष्ट and श्रित subjected to.

n. (-नं)
A bad or disagreeable place or site.
E.
कष्ट, and स्थान place, situation.

f. (-ष्टिः)
1 Test, trial.
2 Pain, trouble.
E.
कष to hurt, क्तिन् aff.

m. (-नः)
A plant, (Justicia, &c.) see वासक.

n. (-रं)
Tin.
E.
कस् to go, deriv. irr.

f. (-का)
Musk; also कस्तूरी and कस्तूरिका.

f. (-का)
See कस्तूरी.

कस्तूरी-मल्लिका^1
f. (-का)
The musk bag.
[1] Correction submitted by Scott Rhodes on 20250526. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/237.

m. (-जः)
Musk.

f. (-री)
1 Musk, the animal perfume so called, as brought from Kashmir, Napal, and western Asam or Butan, the latter is said to be the best.
2 A plant, (Hibiscus abelmoschus.)
3 Another plant, (Amaryllis zeylanica.)
E.
कस to go, and तूरच् affix; its scent going or spreading; the deriv. is irr.; also कन् being added, कस्तूरिका and कस्तुरिका as above.

mfn. (-रः-री-रं)
Who or what goes or moves.
E.
कस to go, वरच् aff.

m. (-कः)
A species of long grass, (Saccharum spontaneum.)
E.
कन् added to the preceding.

m. (-र्द्दः)
See कासमर्द्द.

m. (-र्द्दः)
1 A plant, (Cassia or Senna esculenta.)
2 An acid preparation, a mixture of tamarinds and mustard.
E.
काश or काश cough, and मर्द्द what destroys; also काशमर्द्द.

f. (-लिः)
A kind of silk cotton tree.
E.
का bad, inferior, and शाल्मलि the Simul tree.

m. (-यः)
A name of DHANVANTARI, as king of Benares.
E.
काशिका the city Kāśi, and प्रिय a friend; also काशिराज.

mfn. (-शी-शिनी-शि)
1 Having a cold or cough.
2 Shining, brilliant.
E.
काश cough, and इनि affix, or काश to shine, णिनि aff.

m. (-जः)
A name of DHANVANTARI or DIVODĀSA, a king of Benares, and an author of medical works; he is often confounded with his celestial namesake, the physician of the gods.
E.
काशि the city, and राज a king or ruler; also काशीराज.

m. (-जः)
DIVODĀSA: see काशिराज.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Made of kās grass, abounding with it, &c.
E.
काश, and इल aff.

m. (-थः)
A name of ŚIVA.
E.
काशी Kāśi or Benares, and नाथ lord or master.

m. (-शः)
1 ŚIVA.
2 DIVODĀSA, or any king of Benares.
n. (-शं)
Sulphate of iron.
E.
काशी, and ईश lord.

n. (-सं)
Green vitriol, green sulphate of iron.
E.
कास to go, ईसण् aff.

m. (-रः)
The betel nut tree.

f. (-री)
A plant, commonly Gambhāri, (Gmelina arborea, Rox.) see गम्भारी.
E.
काश to shine, and अर affix, formative irr.; also कार्श्मरी and काश्मर्य्य.

mn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्यं)
Gambhāri, a plant: see the preceding.
E.
यत् added to काश्मरी.

n. (-जं)
1 A costus.
2 Saffron: see कश्मीर.
f. (-जः)
Atis or Betula: see अतिबिषा.
E.
काश्मीर and ज born; produced in Kashmir.

m. (-पिः)
1 A name of ARUṆA.
2 A name of GARUḌA, the bird of VIṢṆU.
E.
कश्यप the saint, and इञ् affix of descent, being both sons of KAŚYAPA.
f. (-पी)
The earth.
E.
as before; alluding to a legend from the Purāṇas, in which [] PARAŚURĀMA, after the destruction of the Kṣatriya race, and performance of an Aśvamedha, presented the sovereignty of the world to his Guru, KAŚYAPA.

m. (-यः)
The sun.
E.
कश्यप the saint, and ढक् affix of descent, the son of KAŚYAPA.

f. (-री)
A plant: see काश्मरी.

n. (-ष्ठं)
Wood.
f. (-ष्ठा)
1 A quarter or region of the world, space, tract.
2 Place, site.
3 Limit, boundary.
4 A measure of time, the thirtieth part of a Kalā, or eighteen twinklings of the eye.
5 Excellence, superiority.
6 A plant, (Curcuma zanthorhiza, Rox.)
E.
काश to shine, Uṇādi affix क्यन्, श changed to ष, and थ after ष becomes ठ.

n. (-कं)
Aloe wood or agallochum.
E.
कन् added to काष्ठ wood.

f. (-ली)
The wild plantain.
E.
काष्ठ, and कदली a plantain; the fruit being hard and woody.

m. (-टः)
A small insect or worm found in decayed wood.
E.
काष्ठ wood, and कीट a worm.

m. (-ट्टः)
A bird, a sort of woodpecker, (Picus Bengalensis.)
E.
काष्ठ, and कुट्ट to cut, अच् aff.

m. (-लः)
A kind of wooden shovel or scraper used for baling water out of a boat, or for scraping and cleaning its bottom, &c.
E.
काष्ठ wood, and कुद्दाल shovel; also with the first vowel long कूद्दाल, काष्ठकूद्दाल.

n. (-ण्डं)
A stick, a spar, a piece of wood.
E.
काष्ठ, and खण्ड piece.

m. (-ट्)
A carpenter.
E.
काष्ठ wood, and तक्ष to cut or pare, affix क्विप्.

m. (-कः)
A carpenter: see the preceding.
E.
as before, वुन् aff.

m. (-न्तुः)
A small worm that is found in timber.
E.
काष्ठ wood, and तन्तु what spreads, from तन with तुन् aff.

m. (-रुः)
The Deodar tree, (Uvaria longifolia.)

m. (-द्रुः)
A tree, (Butea frondosa.)
E.
काष्ठ, and द्रु a tree.

f. (-ठी)
A funeral pile.
E.
काष्ठ wood, and मठी a pile, an edifice.

mfn. (-यः-यी-यं)
Wooden, made of wood.
E.
काष्ठ and मयट् aff.

m. (-ल्लः)
A bier, a plank, &c. on which dead bodies are carried.
E.
काष्ठ wood, and मल्ल a vessel.

m. (-कः)
A small worm found in wood.
E.
काष्ठ, and लेखक who writes or inscribes.

m. (-ही)
A club, a short cudgel, especially if armed with iron.
E.
काष्ठ, लौह iron, and इनि aff.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Having wood for fuel, &c.
ind.
Like a piece of wood.
E.
काष्ठ, and मतुप् or वति aff.

m. (-रः)
A wooden house or enclosure.
E.
काष्ठ, and आगार a house.

f. (-नी)
A wooden bucket or baling vessel: see अम्बुवाहिनी.

mfn. (-ष्ठी-ष्ठिनी-ष्ठि)
1 Of wood, wooden.
2 Having wood.
E.
काष्ठ, and इनि aff.

m. (-ला)
A large kind of Colotropis.
f. (-ला)
A plantain: see रम्भा.
E.
का for कु small, अस्थि bone or stalk, and ला to get or possess; क and टाप् affix; having a stem which is good for nothing.

mfn. (-ण्ठः-ण्ठा-ण्ठं)
Afflicted with cough.
m. (-ण्ठः)
YAMA.

mfn. (-घ्नः-घ्नी-घ्नं)
Removing or alleviating cough, pectoral.
f. (-घ्नी)
A sort of prickly nightshade: see कण्ठकारी.
E.
कास catarrh, and घ्न from हन् to kill, removing cough.

f. (-नी)
A thorny plant: see कर्कटशृङ्गी.
E.
कास catarrh, and नाशिनी removing, remedying.

f. (-का)
An acid drink.

m. (-नः)
A sort of cucumber, (Trichosanthes dioeca.)

m. (-रः)
A buffalo.
E.
क water, and आङ् prefixed to सृ to go, affix अप्; who frequents water, this animal being partial to marshy places.

m. (-रः)
A pond, a pool.
E.
क water, सृ to go, आङ् prefix, and घञ् affix, or कास to shine, आरन् Uṇādi aff.

m. (-रिः)
A plant, (Cassia esculenta): see कासमर्द्द.
E.
कास cough, and अरि a foe.

m. (-लुः)
An esculent root, a sort of yam.

f. (-सूः)
1 Indistinct speech.
2 Speech in general.
3 Understanding.
4 Devotion.
5 Light, lustre.
6 A sort of spear or lance.
E.
कस to go, to shine, or कास to make a bad sound, क Uṇādi aff.

f. (-री)
A short spear, a javelin.
E.
कासू, and ष्टरच् diminutive aff.
